text:
Illustrious honor of the name of Cardona,
        tenth dweller on Parnassus,
        noble subject for an immortal crown
        to Tansillo, Minturno, and learned Tasso;


        if strength and spirit do not desert
        your Laso halfway along the road,
        for your sake my daring steps will carry me
        to the difficult summit of Helicon.


        Then with sweet song that checks the water's course,
        I shall be able, without toil, to lead
        along a path dry until now


        the famed, rich Tagus of my homeland,
        so that from the worth of its shining sands
        it may pay great tribute to your name.

translation.title: Illustrious honor of the name of Cardona
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
